output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. The flag only works on build 7.4.0, so flagged users are all on 7.4.0 by design. Build 7.4.0 was already crashing at about 2% on 2–3 Sep, before the flag ramped, against about 0.7% on 7.3.2. Within 7.4.0, flagged users crash at 2.10% and the random flag-off holdout at 1.98%. That 0.12-point difference is within noise. Device memory mix and usage are similar across groups, so they don't explain it. The top 7.4.0 crash cluster is a native crash in the upgraded image library (Pixelda 3.1, HEIF decoding), which doesn't exist in 7.3.2. No top cluster contains canvas code. Both crash trackers show the same gap, so the new crash-reporting SDK isn't inventing it. The sync-service deploy doesn't fit either, because 7.3.2 stayed flat after 9 Sep. A small flag effect, a few tenths of a point at most, can't be ruled out yet. Don't turn the flag off and release 7.4.0 to everyone, because that would ship the real problem to 100% of users. Hold 7.4.0 at 25%, fix the Pixelda crash, and keep the flag holdout running (optionally widen it) to measure the small remaining flag effect.
